scope: Synchronization integration with actual RGB capture and CameraRobotPort/MuJoCo actuators. Visual stage verdicts are synthetic except the default absent producer UNCERTAIN. No autonomous transport success claim.
success_criteria: Every case satisfies its predeclared command gating, HOLD, expiry or resume assertion
Five stages advance only after both synthetic post-command DONE replies
Missing visual producer never issues a command or advances
Both physical bases move more than 1 mm in wheel diagnostic cases, evaluated after actions
Both physical arms change by more than 0.001 rad in arm diagnostic cases, evaluated after actions
Three actor cameras are unchanged and welds remain OFF
All original RGB requests/replies, events, evaluation-only samples and visual artifacts are retained
limits: No loaded stop or transport test
Local serialized JSON connection, no network or separate process restart
